purpose: Review checklist only; not accepted by the digital shadow CLI

candidate.selection_reason: User requested all quadrupoles; capture selection is independent of model segment and ALL_MAIN membership
candidate.execution_status: Offline structure and GUI import checked; real collector is not implemented; no live connection performed
candidate.capture_scope: All machine profile quadrupoles, plus the existing local screen and context observations

entrance_beam.basis_policy: Use explicitly sourced assumed inputs for engineering prediction until independent real entrance data exist; never use extracted VM particles as a real measurement
entrance_beam.reconstruction_phase: Future PRF06 exit reconstruction candidate, not current QT01 entrance input

reconstruction_structure.status: Design topology check only; no measured RMS input and no accepted reconstruction

snapshot.unit_note: Use existing entry.unit to preserve the source EGU; there is currently no separate raw_egu field
snapshot.current_supported_age_policy: Use the recorded capture window; do not substitute VM evidence or widen the window to cover old multi-screen measurements

diagnostic_definition.target_source_proposed: RMS derived from saved PRF09 raw image, with image PV, frame hash and processing provenance; not the Gaussian SIZE PV
diagnostic_definition.engineering_display_policy: Show model RMS and raw real widths with their separate definitions; gaussian_sigma or unknown observations have no precision residual
diagnostic_definition.target_source_proposed_phase: Future image RMS physics validation; not the current scalar engineering display

known_implementation_gap.unit_alias: Local IOC reference uses m^-2; current snapshot conversion requires exact 1/m^2. Preserve raw EGU and add explicit equivalence handling before any affected real replay
known_implementation_gap.diagnostic_source: Current comparison only accepts mapped sigx/sigy PVs as declared RMS. Image-derived RMS requires an explicit source adapter; do not relabel Gaussian snapshots or forge a SIZE PV origin
known_implementation_gap.real_capture: No real collector/CLI exists; revised capture plan covers 68 profile quadrupoles plus 23 local observations, 159 scalar PVs; retain run-vm isolation
known_implementation_gap.vm_prf09: Real PRF09 SIZE PV mappings exist, but vm.json has no PRF09 sigx/sigy mappings; existing run-vm cannot capture all four screens
known_implementation_gap.quad_strength_mapping: QDU01/02 lack K1_total and K1 aliases current_set; capture native currents without normalized conversion. QHL1..4 are model-only definitions with unresolved real identities

next_stage_proposed.scope: Implement explicit read-only capture for all profile quadrupoles (136 native scalar channels) plus 23 existing local observations; the QT01-to-PRF09 model consumes only its four normalized readbacks; validate with offline injected readers
next_stage_proposed.raw_image_archival_phase: Future measurement/RMS reconstruction; no existing historical frames requested
next_stage_proposed.implementation_status: All-quadrupole scope and offline mapping inspection complete; real capture and comparison adapters remain to be implemented

future_reconstruction_candidate.selection_reason: No independent QT01 entrance measurement; propose PRF06/07/08 image RMS reconstruction at PRF06 exit and hold out PRF09
future_reconstruction_candidate.execution_status: Future measurement candidate only; historical reconstruction cannot be executed

capture_policy.model_input_missing_policy: Do not predict if any readback required by the selected model is missing or unusable. Missing unrelated global states are archived separately and do not masquerade as local model failure; never fall back to K1 settings
capture_policy.observation_missing_policy: Archive quality and reason per channel; preserve unavailable diagnostics, never fabricate residuals
capture_policy.bpm_corrector_ict_role: Archive context only; no orbit, current-to-kick conversion or transmission prediction in this phase
capture_policy.source: All quad devices are derived by kind from machine profile; additional observations are derived from the current local model segment. This remains a review checklist, not a runtime API
capture_policy.scope_completeness: Report global capture completeness separately from the availability of the local model inputs

historical_physics_validation_status: Unavailable from existing historical inputs; user confirmed raw frames and synchronous states do not exist

all_quadrupole_capture.selection_source: Load every machine profile element with kind=quad, independent of chosen model segment
all_quadrupole_capture.raw_current_semantics: QDU01/02 have no K1_total. Their K1 PV equals current_set; archive native current channels, never label those values normalized K1 or invent a conversion
all_quadrupole_capture.model_only_policy: No matching physical-device profile or real PV mapping; preserve as unresolved identities, do not invent channels or assume aliases
